predicates.label: Property
predicates.description: Property a lease, recurring item or work order belongs to

predicates.label: Tenant
predicates.description: The owner's label for the tenant (not the tenant's legal name)

predicates.label: Lease start
predicates.description: First day of the lease, at noon local time

predicates.label: Lease end
predicates.description: Last day of the lease, at noon local time; none while open-ended

predicates.label: Last day to pay
predicates.description: Rent is due from day 1 to this day of each month

predicates.label: Security deposit
predicates.description: Security deposit agreed in the lease, in cents

predicates.label: Increase rule
predicates.description:
none, percent:

or inpc: how the rent increases on each anniversary

predicates.label: Late fee
predicates.description: Fixed late fee per late month, in cents; absent if none

predicates.label: Late fee rate
predicates.description: Late fee per late month as basis points of the rent (500 = 5 %); absent if none

predicates.label: Payment rule
predicates.description: How the owner recognizes rent deposits: types, account, amount

predicates.label: Monthly rent
predicates.description: Rent in force from a date, in cents

predicates.label: Effective from
predicates.description: Day a rent or a rule starts to apply, at noon local time

predicates.label: Rent period
predicates.description: Month of rent (YYYY-MM) a payment covers

predicates.label: Applied amount
predicates.description: Part of a payment applied to one month of rent or to the deposit, in cents

predicates.label: Paid with
predicates.description: Bank transaction or cash receipt that paid it

predicates.label: Under lease
predicates.description: Lease a payment, deposit or settlement belongs to

predicates.label: Reason
predicates.description: The owner's reason, in their words

predicates.label: Kind
predicates.description: service, property_tax, insurance, condo_fee, preventive or other

predicates.label: Who pays
predicates.description: owner or tenant

predicates.label: Every (months)
predicates.description: How often it comes back, in months

predicates.label: Next due
predicates.description: Next due date, at noon local time

predicates.label: Notice (days)
predicates.description: How many days before the due date it shows as pending

predicates.label: Charge rule
predicates.description: Text of the bank description that identifies its charges, and optionally the account

predicates.label: For item
predicates.description: Recurring item or work order an event belongs to

predicates.label: Amount paid
predicates.description: Amount paid for a recurring item, in cents (positive)

predicates.label: Due date
predicates.description: Due date this payment or check covered

predicates.label: Status
predicates.description: reported, quoted, approved, in_progress, done or cancelled

predicates.label: Reported on
predicates.description: Day the work order was reported

predicates.label: Closed on
predicates.description: Day the work was done or cancelled

predicates.label: Quote
predicates.description: Quoted cost, in cents

predicates.label: Final cost
predicates.description: Final cost, in cents

predicates.label: Provider
predicates.description: Provider doing the work

predicates.label: Warranty until
predicates.description: Last day of the warranty, at noon local time

predicates.label: Trade
predicates.description: What the provider does: plumbing, electrical, gas, painting...

predicates.label: Contact
predicates.description: How the owner reaches the provider, as the owner gave it

predicates.label: Rating
predicates.description: The owner's rating, 1 to 5

predicates.label: Note
predicates.description: The owner's note

predicates.label: Refund
predicates.description: Deposit returned to the tenant, in cents (negative if the tenant owes)

predicates.label: Deductions
predicates.description: Total deducted from the deposit, in cents

predicates.label: Deduction details
predicates.description: Each deduction and its reason, as the owner gave them
